purpose: The packet ledger-additions.md is a byte copy of the private source. Its routes cell on these rows separates qualifiers from routes with semicolons, which apps/site/src/lab/ledger.ts parseLedger rejects (each semicolon piece must be a route). The canonical feedback-ledger.md rows therefore join each non-route qualifier to the preceding route with a comma in the routes cell ONLY. Words, ids, dates, who, verdict and source cells are byte-identical to ledger-additions.md.
